title: Foundation of the Tang dynasty
shortSummary: The dynastic transition of 618 reorganized the political, educational and religious resource environment of Chang'an.
curatorialDescription: The timeline emphasizes institutional change rather than reducing the foundation to one biographical instant.
researchNote: Control of the capital, institutional continuity and transitions of individual institutions remain to be separated.
